stzOrgChart.code:
oOrg = new stzOrgChart("acme")
oOrg {
    AddExecutivePosition("ceo")
    AddManagementPosition("cfo")
    AddStaffPosition("clerk")

    ReportsTo("cfo", "ceo")
    ReportsTo("clerk", "cfo")
}

# three positions
? oOrg.NumberOfNodes()

oOrg = new stzOrgChart("acme")
oOrg {
    AddExecutivePosition("ceo")
    AddStaffPosition("rogue")
    ReportsTo("rogue", "rogue")
}

oRep = new stzRuleReport("acme")
# the org chart checks itself into the gate
oRep.Collect(oOrg)

# the gate collected orgchart findings
? len(oRep.FindingsOfSubject("orgchart")) >= 1

stzCalendar.code:
StzCalendarQ([2024, 10]) {

    SetWorkingDays([ "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday" ])

    # Thu 2024-10-03 is a working day
    ? IsWorkingDay("2024-10-03")

    # Sat 2024-10-05 is not a working day
    ? IsWorkingDay("2024-10-05")

    # October 2024 has 23 working days
    ? len(WorkingDays())
}

StzCalendarQ([2024, 10]) {

    AddHoliday("2024-10-15", "National Day")

    # the 15th is a holiday
    ? IsHoliday("2024-10-15")

    # the 16th is not
    ? IsHoliday("2024-10-16")

    # and the holiday has a name
    ? HolidayName("2024-10-15")
}

stzString.code:
o1 = new stzString("s㊱m")

# three characters, not five bytes
? o1.NumberOfChars()

# the second one is the circled number
? o1[2]

o1 = new stzString("...emm...eh..emm...eh")

# where is "emm"?
? @@( o1.Find("emm") )

# and what are the first and last positions of each?
? @@( o1.FindAsSections("emm") )

# every character has a name, and the name says what it is
? @@NL( Q("◐◰☁").CharsNames() )

o1 = new stzString("hello world")

# Replaced returns a changed copy and leaves the string alone
? o1.Replaced("world", "Softanza")
? o1.Content()

# Replace changes the string itself
o1.Replace("world", "Softanza")
? o1.Content()

stzRegex.code:
o1 = new stzRegex("[a-z]+@[a-z]+\.com")

# Match anchors the pattern on the whole text
? o1.Match("kal@stz.com")
? o1.Match("write to kal@stz.com")

# MatchFirst looks for it anywhere
? o1.MatchFirst("write to kal@stz.com")

o1 = new stzRegex("\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}")

# the text is on its way to a match
? o1.MatchAsYouType("123-45")

# this one can never become one
? o1.MatchAsYouType("abc")

stzList.code:
o1 = new stzList([ "abcde", "a", "abc", "ab", "abcd" ])

# the predicate is a string that the engine evaluates
o1.SortBy('len(@item)')
? @@( o1.Content() )

o1 = new stzList([
    "you",
    "other",
    [ "other", "you", [ "you" ], "other" ],
    "other",
    "you"
])

# three levels deep
? o1.NumberOfLevels()

# every place where "you" sits, at any depth
? @@( o1.DeepFind("you") )

o1 = new stzList([ 5, 3, 8 ])

# Added returns a copy with the item and leaves the list alone
? @@( o1.Added(1) )
? @@( o1.Content() )

# Add changes the list itself
o1.Add(1)
? @@( o1.Content() )

stzNumber.code:
? Q(17).IsPrime()

? Q(169).IsPrime()

# the numbers that divide 54
? @@( Q(54).Factors() )

# and the prime ones among them
? @@( Q(54).PrimeFactors() )

# 5! is 120
? Q(5).Factorial()

# GCD(12, 18) is 6
? Q(12).GCD(18)

# LCM(4, 6) is 12
? Q(4).LCM(6)

# Fibonacci(10) is 55
? Q(10).Fibonacci()

# the same question, asked at two precisions
? Q(5.12).IsEqualTo(5.1200000000000001)

? Q(5.12).IsEqualTo([ 5.1200000000000001, :Round = 16 ])

stzListOfNumbers.code:
o1 = new stzListOfNumbers([ 2, 7, 18, 10, 12, 25, 4 ])

# the number of the list that is nearest to 17
? o1.Nearest(17)

# and to 88
? o1.Nearest(88)

o1 = new stzListOfNumbers([ 1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 ])

# the distinct steps between consecutive numbers
? @@( o1.Steps() )

# the running total
o1.Cumulate()
? @@( o1.Content() )

o1 = new stzListOfNumbers([ 4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42 ])

# every number goes under the centre it is nearest to
? @@( o1.ClassifyByNearestTo([ 5, 20 ]) )

stzHashList.code:
o1 = new stzHashList([ :math = 18, :stats = 16, :history = 14 ])

# read a value by its key
? o1[:stats]

# the keys, in the order they were given
? @@( o1.Keys() )

# which positions hold the value 18?
? @@( o1.FindValue(18) )

o1 = new stzHashList([ [ "NAME", "Mansour" ], [ "AGE", 45 ] ])

# keys are folded to lowercase
? @@( o1.Content() )

stzText.code:
o1 = new stzText("I love this library, it is wonderful")

? o1.Sentiment()

? o1.IsPositive()

o1 = new stzText("Mansour lives in Niamey and works for Softanza")

# who and where, found by rules, with no model
? @@NL( o1.NamedEntities() )

o1 = new stzText("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog")

? @@( o1.NounPhrases() )

stzGraph.code:
oG = new stzGraph("trip")
oG {
    AddNode("A")
    AddNode("B")
    AddNode("C")

    AddEdge("A", "B")
    AddEdge("B", "C")
}

# a path can be coloured with two colours
? oG.IsBipartite()

# add the edge that closes the triangle
oG.AddEdge("A", "C")
? oG.IsBipartite()

oG = new stzGraph("roads")
oG {
    AddNodes([ "A", "B", "C", "D" ])

    AddEdge("A", "B")
    AddEdge("B", "C")
    AddEdge("C", "D")
    AddEdge("A", "D")
}

# the shortest way from A to C
? @@( oG.ShortestPath("A", "C") )

oG = new stzGraph("network")
oG {
    AddNodes([ "A", "B", "C" ])

    AddEdgeXTT("A", "B", "link", [ :weight = 1 ])
    AddEdgeXTT("B", "C", "link", [ :weight = 2 ])
    AddEdgeXTT("A", "C", "link", [ :weight = 5 ])
}

# the cheapest tree that connects all three
? oG.MSTWeight()

stzDiagram.code:
o1 = new stzDiagram("flow")
o1 {
    AddNode("start")
    AddNode("check")
    AddNode("done")

    AddEdge("start", "check")
    AddEdge("check", "done")
}

# a diagram is a graph, so it answers like one
? o1.NumberOfNodes()

# and it knows how it will be drawn
? o1.Layout()

? o1.Notation()

# the picture is vector, and needs no device
? StzFindFirst("<svg", o1.ToSVG()) > 0

stzGeoMap.code:
cJson = '{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"A"},"geometry":{"type":"Polygon","coordinates":[[[0,0],[4,0],[4,4],[0,4],[0,0]]]}}]}'

oMap = StzGeoMap(new stzGeoProjection(:mercator), StzGeoFeaturesFromJson(cJson))

# one well falls inside region A
? @@( oMap.CountPointsIn([ 2, 3 ]) )

# and the density the region carries
? @@( oMap.DensityPointsIn([ 2, 3 ]) )

stzCanvas.code:
o1 = new stzCanvas(300, 120)
o1 {
    SetBackground("white")
    AddRect(10, 10, 120, 100)
    AddCircle(220, 60, 40)
}

# the same picture, as SVG: vector, with no device

stzDataSet.code:
o1 = new stzDataSet([ 2, 4, 4, 5, 7, 9, 12, 25 ])

# the outlier pulls the mean up
? o1.Mean()

# and leaves the median where it was
? o1.Median()

oX = new stzDataSet([ 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ])
oY = new stzDataSet([ 2, 1, 4, 3, 6 ])
oZ = new stzDataSet([ 3, 1, 4, 1, 5 ])

# how X moves with Y
? oX.CorrelationWith(oY)

# and the same, once Z is held fixed
? oX.PartialCorrelation(oY, oZ)

stzDateTime.code:
o1 = StzDateTimeQ("2024-03-15 10:30:00")

# the same moment, written for three readers
? o1.ToEuropean()

? o1.ToAmerican()

? o1.ToLong()

o1 = StzDateTimeQ("2024-03-15 10:00:00")

# arithmetic in words
o1 + "2 days 5 hours"
? o1.Content()

# and the distance between two moments, in the unit you name
o2 = StzDateTimeQ("2024-03-15 10:00:00")
? o2.DurationTo("2024-03-20 14:30:15", :In = :Days)
